reasons.plausibility: Substituting Hf with Al to reduce mass while preserving solid-solution strengthening is scientifically plausible for RHEAs, though the exact effect on high-temperature performance is not guaranteed.
reasons.testability: They propose a clear series of alloys, standard density and strength measurements, and a direct ±10% acceptance range, which makes the test well-defined and decisive if those targets are not met.
reasons.usefulness: This addresses a key issue (lower density) with a workable strategy and clear targets, so it would be highly relevant to those developing lower-density RHEAs.
